title: Current identity
intent: The familiar calculator, capsule, and circular arrows. Explicit about the tool and its purpose; included as the continuity reference.

title: Conversion arrows
intent: Opposing arrows and an equals sign above calc.med. A compact conversion symbol with a warm gold accent.

title: Balanced measures
intent: Paired measured forms make comparison the central idea. A restrained mathematical identity with a clear, horizontal name.

title: Transfer loop
intent: Interlocking arcs turn conversion into a compact, continuous symbol. Retains the movement of the current arrows in a simpler mark.

title: Clinical monogram
intent: A compact c/m monogram gives the site a recognizable signature. Geometry and negative space carry the identity without a literal medical icon.

title: Conversion grid
intent: A modular mathematical grid recalls a calculator. The emphasis is on a precise, practical tool with a strong small symbol.

title: Typographic precision
intent: The name does the work. Carefully shaped lettering and a deliberate dot create a quieter, more editorial identity.

title: Shared baseline
intent: Different measured paths meet a common reference. An abstract expression of standardization, with a calm scientific character.
